name: How does AI support green building and historic conservation work?

mainEntity.name: How does AI support green building and historic conservation work?

acceptedAnswer.text: AI-assisted analysis helps forecast energy use, evaluate sustainable materials, and support precise 3D documentation, which is especially valuable for historic homes that need sensitive upgrades.
